status: PROVISIONAL — engineering-complete (contrast-verified) but pending Milestone A owner visual acceptance (docs/SITE-ARCHITECTURE.md §16)

authority.brand_note: CPMS remains the product identifier. Final commercial branding (name/identity) is an OPEN BUSINESS DECISION (docs/ROADMAP.md §21); these are design-system engineering values, not final commercial branding.

color.policy: Role-based usage only. Arbitrary per-page hex values are prohibited (docs/SITE-ARCHITECTURE.md §8). Status colors always ship with icon + text, never color alone.

surface/raised.usage: Menus, popovers, raised layers — separated via shadow/raised, not fill.

ink/muted.usage: Captions, meta, helper text (text-size roles only).

accent/primary.usage: Primary CTA fill, links, focus ring, active state.

accent/contrast-on-accent.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

link.usage: Inline text links. Shares the accent family by policy; kept as its own role to allow future divergence.

border/subtle.usage: Decorative dividers only — never the sole boundary of a control.

success.usage: Success text/icon on light surfaces; tint fills at low alpha.

warning.usage: Warning text/icon on light surfaces; tint fills at low alpha.

danger.usage: Danger text/icon on light surfaces; tint fills at low alpha.

info.usage: Info text/icon on light surfaces; tint fills at low alpha.

color.contrast_standard: WCAG 2.2 Level AA: 4.5:1 normal text (SC 1.4.3), 3:1 large text and non-text UI (SC 1.4.11).

persian.name: Vazirmatn
persian.loading: self-hosted woff2; font-display: swap; no third-party font requests

typography.letter_spacing: 0 — letter-spacing on the Persian joined script is prohibited (breaks glyph connections).
typography.numerals: Persian digits (۰-۹) in narrative text; Latin digits for technical/communicative values (docs/SITE-ARCHITECTURE.md §9.4).
typography.punctuation: Persian punctuation rules apply (ZWNJ half-spaces, «…» quotes, Persian question mark) — docs/SITE-ARCHITECTURE.md §9.3.

spacing.policy: Ad-hoc spacing values are prohibited; vertical rhythm of page blocks comes from this scale (docs/SITE-ARCHITECTURE.md §8).

container.edge_to_edge_policy: Media may bleed to the viewport edges; text never exceeds content-default width.

border.policy: Small fixed radius from this scale only (no pill/rounded-full); borders calmer than surfaces.

shadow.policy: Exactly these two levels; no decorative blur/glassmorphism (docs/SITE-ARCHITECTURE.md §7.1).

focus.policy: Visible on every interactive element via :focus-visible; never removed without an equivalent replacement (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7).

motion.reduced_motion: When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — durations become 0, parallax/auto-animation stay off, affordances are preserved (docs/SITE-ARCHITECTURE.md §8).

breakpoints.policy: Ranges follow docs/SITE-ARCHITECTURE.md §10 (Mobile 320-767 / Tablet 768-1024 / Laptop 1025-1365 / Desktop 1366+). Elementor keeps its non-deletable defaults Mobile=767 and Tablet=1024; the optional Laptop breakpoint is activated and set to 1365 so Desktop starts at 1366.

elementor.status: SPEC ONLY — NOT APPLIED. No Elementor kit or settings export/import has been performed; reconstruction clean_import_pilot = NOT RUN.

global_colors.note: System slots (Primary/Secondary/Text/Accent) cannot be deleted in Elementor and carry the four core roles; every remaining role is added once as a custom global color named after its role.

global_fonts.note: Global font styles carry family + weight + line-height; the exact per-level size is applied per widget from the scale (an Elementor global font style carries one size).

site_settings.theme_style: Headings, links, buttons, forms and images of non-Elementor HTML bind to the same tokens.

custom_fonts_feature.preferred: Elementor -> Custom Fonts (font-family 'Vazirmatn', weights 400/700, woff2 only; documented vendor workflow).
custom_fonts_feature.pro_boundary: Secondary sources attribute Custom Fonts to Elementor Pro; the free-vs-Pro boundary on the installed real-host version is NOT VERIFIED.
custom_fonts_feature.fallback: If the Custom Fonts feature is unavailable on the installed edition, a minimal @font-face CSS layer is justified (self-hosted Persian font is a required capability; no third-party font CDN is acceptable).

css_support_required.reason: Elementor has no global focus-ring control; required for WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7.
Elementor has no global reduced-motion control; required by the motion policy.

css_support_required.feature: logical properties (margin-inline / padding-inline) in any custom CSS
css_support_required.reason: RTL-native flow without physical left/right hacks (docs/SITE-ARCHITECTURE.md §9.1, §9.10).

elementor.add_on_packs: Elementor add-on packs are prohibited unless separately justified and approved.
